title: Campaign videos
content:
Videos from the campaign that don't have a poster of their own. They live on the GitHub release, not in git.

Pillar stages

An 8-bit stage select, a power card, a live demo recorded on the real haxtheweb.org, and a stage-clear card, 42 seconds each. Every stage also comes as four separate segment files on the release.

  • Accessible
  • Efficient
  • Extensible
  • Free and Open
  • Platform Agnostic
  • Remixable
  • Sustainable
